description: This file implements a TLS listener with certificate validation, CRL checking, and SAN verification for secure network connections in the etcd project.

classes.name: tlsListener
classes.description: A custom TLS listener that manages TLS handshakes, certificate validation, and CRL checking.

methods.name: NewTLSListener
methods.description: Creates a new TLS listener that performs TLS handshake and optional CRL checking.

methods.name: newTLSListener
methods.description: Internal function to initialize a TLS listener with configuration and check functions.

methods.name: Accept
methods.description: Accepts incoming connections, returning a net.Conn or error.

methods.name: acceptLoop
methods.description: Handles incoming TLS connections, performing handshakes and validation in separate goroutines.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the TLS listener and cleans up resources.
